arguments.text: Good start. Settle now, long smooth strokes, race pace.

6000 m, out-and-back legs of 1250 m. Start was hot (pod 286 W vs CP 197 W, pod reserve 60% at 1 min). Plan: settle to about pod CP (195-205 W) through the middle, keep pod reserve above about 30% until 1500 m to go, then build; final sprint (finish) at about 400-500 m to go if reserve allows. Watch for things that slow the boat that are not the paddler: speed drop with pod power steady (rudder weed -> clear_rudder), pod reading drift, wind or current shifts, radio course changes.

arguments.message: GPS speed well below what pod power gives, beyond fitted current: weed on rudder, drag, or pod reading high?
Pod reserve below 15% with more than 800 m to go

arguments.reason: decide when to start building toward the finish

text: Cued ease after a hot start (pod 286 W vs CP 197 W, reserve 60%); set plan, drag and low-reserve watches, wake-ups at 1500 m and 550 m to go.

arguments.text: Ease a touch more. Breathe, save it for later.

4.0 min (770 m): pod 217 W vs CP 197, pod reserve 19%, boat reserve 16%. Cued ease twice. Paddler says 6/10, feeling good, could go harder. Possible CP underestimate (test can be 10-25% off) - do not trust reserve blindly; if they hold about 210-220 W with reserve near 0 and no speed fade or blow-up, raise CP (set_critical_power). Until confirmed, keep near CP 195-205 W.

text: Cued ease: pod reserve 19% and still above CP with 5.2 km to go; paddler says 6/10, noted possible CP underestimate to check.

arguments.reason: cue allowed: pod still 210 W above CP 197 with pod reserve 13%; cue ease to about CP

text: no cue: gate closed for 11 s; woke myself at the gate to ease to CP (pod reserve 13%, still 210 W).

arguments.text: Reserve nearly empty. Ease off a little now, recover, long race.

text: Cued ease: pod 212 W above CP 197 with pod reserve 12% and 5 km to go; last ease barely took.

arguments.text: 8.3 min: POD READING DRIFTING LOW. Leg 1 out: GPS 3.15, pod 216 W, boat 144 W, rate 62.7. Leg 2 back: GPS 3.47, pod 170 W (falling smoothly 212->153 since 5.5 min), boat 146 W, rate 62.4. Same boat power and rate both legs, current fits symmetric +-0.16 -> paddler effort unchanged, pod reads ~25% low and still falling. Do NOT trust shaft_power_w, w_bal_pod_frac (falsely refilling), push_local_mps. Use boat model (power_w, reserve_left_pct, fade_pct) and legs(). Boat reserve reads 0% at 145 W vs CP 134 but no fade (+0.6%) and paddler 5/10 plenty: CP 134 may be too low; if no fade by ~10 min, raise boat CP to ~145.

6000 m, out-and-back legs of 1250 m. POD IS DRIFTING LOW from 5.5 min: ignore pod power, pod reserve and push_local; pace from boat model (power_w, reserve_left_pct, fade_pct) and legs(). Middle: hold about 145 W boat power (rate ~62) unless fade appears; boat CP 134 looks too low (no fade at 0% reserve) - raise it if confirmed. Build from about 1500 m to go, final sprint (finish) at 400-500 m to go. Watch fade_pct for a blow-up or rudder weed (speed drops at same rate).

arguments.message: Speed through water at this rate down >3% vs early race: blow-up, weed on rudder, or drag

arguments.reason: check whether boat power holds ~145 W without fade at 0% boat reserve; if so raise boat CP

text: no cue: pod reading is drifting low (same boat power and rate on both legs), effort steady at ~145 W boat with no fade; switched to boat-model watches, re-check CP in 100 s.

arguments.text: 10.1 min: boat power steady 145-146 W, boat reserve 0% for 3 min, no fade (+0.5%), pod steady ~152 W, eta_est rising 0.66->0.70. Two hypotheses: (1) pod reads low, effort unchanged -> boat CP really ~145+, hold; (2) pod right, paddler eased to 153 W and a strong tailwind/current (~0.55 m/s) helps leg 2 -> they have lots in hand, should push. Decisive test: leg 3 (north, out). If leg 3 GPS ~3.1-3.2 with boat ~145 W and pod ~150 -> pod drift confirmed, raise boat CP to ~146. If leg 3 GPS much slower (<2.9) -> leg-2 assist was wind/current, trust pod, push.

arguments.reason: about 70 s into leg 3: compare legs() to decide pod drift vs tailwind, then CP and push/hold

text: no cue: effort steady at ~145 W boat with no fade; waiting for leg 3 to tell pod drift from a leg-2 tailwind before changing CP or pace.

arguments.text: Strong. Hold this effort now, we push from 1500 to go.

12.0 min (3600 m to go): paddler said feeling great, going; boat power rising 145->151, pod 164. Cued hold (cap the early surge) until CP is settled. Leg-3 test still valid with changing effort: ratio boat/pod power. Pod-drift case: ratio stays ~0.93-0.95 on leg 3 (as on leg 2). Tailwind case: ratio drops back to ~0.66 on leg 3 (as on leg 1).

text: Cued hold: paddler started an early surge with 3.6 km to go while true CP is still uncertain; leg-3 check pending.

arguments.reason: Held 144 W boat power for 10 min with no fade (steady_power_10min_w 144) while the reserve model read below 5% for 400 s, after a hot start; paddler repeatedly says plenty in hand. Test CP 134 is too low; 148 is a cautious estimate.

arguments.text: 13.7 min: POD DRIFT CONFIRMED on leg 3 (north): GPS 3.13 at boat 142-150 W, pod only 155 W (ratio ~0.96 as on leg 2; was 0.66 before 5.5 min). Effort has been steady ~145 W boat all race. Set boat CP 134 -> 148 (1st of 3 changes): steady 144 W for 10 min, no fade, reserve model below 5% for 400 s. Pod numbers (shaft power, pod reserve, sustainable shaft power) remain meaningless.

6000 m, out-and-back legs of 1250 m (turn at each end; current about 0.2 m/s, against going out/north, helping coming back). POD READS LOW since 5.5 min: ignore pod power, pod reserve, push_local; use boat model (power_w, reserve_left_pct, sustainable_power_w, fade_pct) and legs(). Boat CP raised 134 -> 148 at 13.7 min (1 of 3 changes used); boat reserve then 75%. Middle: hold about 150 W boat (rate ~62), near sustainable_power_w. From 1500 m to go build if reserve allows; final sprint (finish) about 400-500 m to go. If fade_pct drops below -3 at steady rate: blow-up (CP too high, lower it) or weed (clear_rudder).

text: no cue: confirmed pod drift on leg 3, raised boat CP to 148 W (reserve now 75%); paddler at ~150 W is about on sustainable pace.

arguments.text: Breather done. Back to race rhythm now, you have plenty.

20.0 min (3350 m to go): paddler took a breather after the leg-4 turn: boat power 147 -> 101-112 W, pod fell in the same ratio (real effort drop, not weed: push_local above push_along). Paddler says 7/10, just a breather, fine. Boat reserve 78% at CP 148. Cued push back to race rhythm (~148-152 W). If they fade or say they are cooked, CP 148 may be too high.

arguments.message: Boat power below 135 W for 75 s: breather dragging on, or blow-up

text: Cued push: paddler took a breather (112 W vs 148 W) with 78% reserve and 3.35 km to go; set a watch in case effort stays low.
no cue: the fade alert is the paddler breather (pod fell in the same ratio as boat power, so not weed); push cue given 30 s ago, waiting for it to act.

no cue: paddler is already building back (30-s power 114 -> 136 W and rising, instant about 140+), near race pace; a second push could overshoot.

arguments.reason: Two forced drops (19.3 min to ~102 W, 24 min to ~122 W) each after 2-3 min at 146-153 W, effort rising 5->7->8/10: classic empty-reserve oscillation. CP 148 too high; 143 fits steady 144 W for 10 min then emptying at ~19 min and again at 24 min.

arguments.text: RACE 7250 m (radio at 14 min added a leg; computer set, paddler told). Legs 1250 m; turns at 5000 and 6250 m; last leg 6250->7250 is south WITH current (~+0.2), leg 5 north AGAINST. POD READS LOW since 5.5 min: ignore pod numbers; use boat model. Boat CP: 134 -> 148 (13.7 min) -> 143 (24.2 min; 2 of 3 changes used) after two forced drops (19.3 and 24 min) each 2-3 min after surging to 146-153 W. Paddler surges after each dip and says just a breather / feel strong: do not believe it. Rest of race: steady at about 140-143 W boat, no surges (hold cue, optional pace target ~161 s/500 on leg 5 north, ~143 s/500 on last leg south). Final sprint (finish) about 400 m to go.

24.2 min (2480 m to go): second forced drop (power 153 -> 141 -> 122 W) after rebuilding to 153 W; paddler 8/10, says just a breather. Lowered boat CP 148 -> 143 (reserve then 45% by the model, which may still be optimistic). When they come back up, cue hold to stop another surge above ~145 W.

arguments.message: Power back above 137 W after the dip: cue hold at steady ~141-143 W before it overshoots

arguments.reason: last turn: last leg is with current; set pace / plan the build and final sprint

text: no cue: second forced drop after a surge to 153 W; lowered boat CP to 143 and set a watch to cue a steady hold when the paddler rebuilds.
no cue: fade alert is the forced drop already diagnosed (CP lowered to 143); waiting for the rebuild watch to cue a steady hold.

arguments.text: Steady now. Even effort this leg, no surges.

25.3 min (2270 m to go, at the leg-5 turn, heading north into current): cued hold with target 161 s/500 over the ground (about 143 W on this leg) to stop the next surge. At the last turn (1000 m to go) the current helps: the same effort is about 143 s/500, so re-cue there or the old target makes them ease.

text: Cued hold at 161 s/500 for the upstream leg (about CP 143 W) so the paddler rebuilds to an even effort instead of surging into a third blow-up.

arguments.text: Good. Lift a little now, steady and even to the turn.

28.3 min (1735 m to go, leg 5 upstream, turn at 6250 m): power 130 W, below the 161 target (pace 165). Model reserve 76% at CP 143 is likely optimistic (its refill is faster than the dips suggest; my estimate of the true reserve ~25-30%). Cued push to 160 s/500 (about 145 W upstream; effort upstream saves more time than downstream). Plan: at the last turn re-cue for the downstream leg (~143-145 s/500), final sprint about 400 m to go.

text: Cued push to 160 s/500 on the upstream leg: power 130 W was below CP 143 with 1735 m to go, and effort upstream buys the most time.
no cue: fade alert is low effort (126 W, below CP), not drag; push to 160 s/500 was cued 20 s ago and the paddler says 6/10, could go harder, so letting it act.
no cue: gate closed 14 s and my 1500-m wake-up is due in about 25 s; will cue the build then.

arguments.text: 1500 to go. Build steadily now, smooth and strong.

At the last turn (1000 m to go, downstream) re-cue: same effort is about 143 s/500; no target slower than that. Final sprint about 400 m to go (wake at 550).

text: Cued push after a third drop to 104 W (paddler 9/10, cooked); saving the final sprint cue for about 450 m to go.
